text_block_list.text:
One day, when both the Aoharu Cup and the 
Twinkle Series had settled down, 
Chairwoman Akikawa summoned the team.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Through all the peaks and valleys, you've 
run brilliantly to make it this far!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"And above all else! You did wonderfully 
in the Aoharu Cup!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Victory slipped from her grasp, but—even 
so!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
A team fighting as one! And the Trainer 
who believed in that team to the very end!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
It is no exaggeration to say that your 
earnest feelings have saved a team, and a 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Let us applaud your valiant effort! 
Magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Saved a certain team, you say? I have no 
recollection of doing so, however...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Still, as long as you're happy, all is OK! 
Yes it is!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: And team training was super fun too!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I feel like my luck has gotten a total, 
massive booost too!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice is also... um, really glad she joined 
the team.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mm! If you enjoyed yourselves, that is 
what matters most! I look forward to 
seeing more great achievements from all of 
you!

I vowed together with <chrname> to keep answering 
Chairwoman Akikawa's passionate feelings 
from here on out!
